answer: In the context of the FRIA ontology as described in arXiv 2501.10391, 'intended purpose' refers to the declaration of why the AI system is needed or to be used, which includes details such as the AI technique and data involved. It is a broad concept that goes beyond just the objective or goal. On the other hand, 'intended use' is interpreted as the contextual application of that purpose in specific scenarios or deployments. This means that the same AI system with one intended purpose can have different intended uses depending on variations in input and output data, the human subjects involved, and the hardware and software being used.
